description: Cleaned up AGENTS.md to remove global duplicates and added project-specific guidelines for llama-server-docker (VRAM awareness, config consistency, and validation workflow).

Baseline: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on RTX 3090. First working benchmark run. composite_score=45 (agent=52%, think=37%, speed=7%, reliability=100%). Speed scores low due to 4-5s latency on quick tasks. Planning and debugging tests scoring 0 - scoring criteria may need tuning. ~60 t/s decode speed.

asi.hypothesis: Baseline benchmark of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to establish reference scores for all 3 slots
asi.key_findings: Planning and debugging score 0 despite model generating good content - scoring keywords too narrow. Speed QA only 1 point despite 4.7s response - speed thresholds may be too aggressive. Reliability perfect (5/5). ~60 t/s decode.
asi.next_action_hint: Test qwen35-27b next for comparison. Consider broadening scoring keywords for planning/debugging tests.

description: Qwen3.5-27B: composite=95 (agent=100%, think=93%, speed=85%, reliability=100%). Quality dominates but SLOW: 8.4 t/s on tool use (21s), ~30 t/s average. Planning=10/10 vs 35B-A3B=0/10. Confirms quality/speed tradeoff.

asi.hypothesis: Compare Qwen3.5-27B dense against 35B-A3B baseline. Expect higher quality but much slower.
asi.key_findings: 27B dominates quality: agent=100%, think=93%, reliability=100% vs 35B-A3B. But 2x slower: 8.4 t/s tool use vs 60.8. Speed QA is only 3s (faster than expected for simple tasks). Planning=10/10 (35B got 0/10 - 35B may use thinking tags that break keyword matching).
asi.speed_vs_quality_tradeoff: 27B quality is clearly superior but 21s for tool use task is too slow for agentic workflows. This is the core tension.
asi.next_action_hint: Test qwen35-9b next for speed reference. Then test glm and gemma4 models. Need to add time penalty to composite score.

description: Qwen3.5-9B: composite=31. reliability=0 (hallucinated fake React hook), planning=0. Same bug fix quality as 27B but faster. NOT a good slot 3 candidate.

asi.hypothesis: Test Qwen3.5-9B speed model. Expect fast but lower quality.
asi.key_findings: 9B composite=31 vs 27B=95. Reliability=0 (hallucinated about fake React 22 hook - confirms dementia). Planning=0, debugging=0. Bug fix same quality as 27B (5 pts) at 2x speed (63 t/s). Tool use slow at 22 t/s due to long prompt.
asi.conclusion: 9B is NOT a good slot 3 candidate - too unreliable for automated tasks. Need a model that is both fast AND reliable.
asi.next_action_hint: Test glm next (APEX ELO leader). Then test gemma4-26b and gemma4-31b.

description: GLM-4.7-Flash: composite=14 (low due to scoring mismatch). FASTEST model: 100 t/s, 2.5s QA. Quality scores 0 but likely scoring keywords too narrow. APEX #1 local coder.

asi.hypothesis: Test GLM-4.7-Flash (APEX ELO leader for local coding). Expected high quality.
asi.key_findings: GLM scores 14 on benchmark but this is likely a scoring issue not a model issue. BLAZING fast: 100 t/s decode, 2.5s quick QA, 7.7s planning. Bug fix=0, algorithm=0, planning=0, reliability=0 despite being APEX #1. The keyword matching is too Qwen-centric.
asi.real_assessment: GLM is likely the best speed+quality candidate. The scoring needs to be more lenient or use LLM-as-judge. 100 t/s is 2x faster than Qwen35-A3B and 3x faster than 27B.
asi.next_action_hint: Test gemma4-26b and gemma4-31b. Then fix scoring to be less keyword-dependent. Consider saving actual responses for manual review.

description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B: composite=98 (NEW BEST). Perfect: think=100%, speed=100%, reliability=100%. 872ms QA, 90 t/s avg. Best all-rounder so far.

asi.hypothesis: Test Gemma 4 26B-A4B. Community says 80-110 t/s on 3090, great speed.
asi.key_findings: Gemma4-26b composite=98 (NEW BEST). Perfect scores: think=100%, speed=100%, reliability=100%. Speed QA=872ms (fastest!). 90 t/s average decode. Tool use slow at 8.7 t/s (15s for long prompt) but that's due to prompt length, not model speed.
asi.model_fit: Could serve as both Slot 2 (thinker) and Slot 3 (speed). Only 16GB so fits VRAM easily. No vision though.
asi.next_action_hint: Test gemma4-31b (has vision) for Slot 2 comparison.

description: Gemma 4 31B: composite=96. agent=100%, think=93%, reliability=100%. Has vision but 3x slower than 26B (27 t/s vs 90). Quality excellent.

asi.hypothesis: Test Gemma 4 31B (has vision) for Slot 2 comparison vs 26B.
asi.key_findings: 31B composite=96 vs 26B=98. Quality nearly identical (agent=100%, think=93%, reliability=100%) but 3x slower (27 t/s vs 90 t/s). 31B has vision capability. Takes 36s for algorithm task vs 11s for 26B.
asi.tradeoff: 31B adds vision but loses 70% speed. For Slot 2 (thinker) where quality matters more than speed, the vision capability may justify the slower speed.
asi.next_action_hint: Test qwopus35-27b. Then consider whether 3 slots should be: 26B (fast all-rounder), 27B (quality), 31B (vision).

description: Qwopus3.5-27B: composite=96. reliability=11 (best). think=100%, speed=29 t/s. Ties Gemma4-31b. Has vision.

asi.hypothesis: Test Qwopus3.5-27B as alternative Slot 2 candidate.
asi.key_findings: Qwopus composite=96, same as Gemma4-31b. reliability=11 (best ever, strongly anti-hallucination). think=100%, debug=9. Speed similar to 27B dense (29 t/s). Has vision capability.
asi.model_assessment: Strong quality+reliability model but same speed tier as 27B dense. No clear advantage over 27B for this benchmark.
asi.next_action_hint: All 7 models tested. Now analyze results and write recommendations. Key finding: Gemma4-26b is the surprise winner at 98 composite.

description: GLM-4.7 fixed (reasoning_content): composite=95. 100 t/s, 2.6s speed tasks. Ties with 27B on quality, 3x faster.

asi.hypothesis: Fix GLM scoring by reading reasoning_content field.
asi.key_findings: GLM jumps 14->95. 100 t/s, quality=95/93/100%. Competes with 27B on quality but 3x faster.
asi.next_action_hint: Test gemma4-31b for vision. Finalize 3-slot recommendation.

description: Gemma 4 31B: composite=95. agent=100%, think=100%, has vision. 14% speed penalty (4.2s avg). Same tier as 27B/GLM but slower.

asi.hypothesis: Test Gemma 4 31B with time-weighted scoring. Has vision, key differentiator.
asi.key_findings: 31B=95 with 14% speed penalty (4.2s avg). Same quality as 27B/GLM but slower. agent=100%, think=100%. Vision is the unique selling point.
asi.conclusion: 31B is only worth it if vision is critical for Slot 2. Otherwise 26B is strictly better (same quality, 3x faster).
asi.next_action_hint: Write final recommendation. The data is clear enough for a solid 3-slot recommendation.

description: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B re-test: composite=89. Still below top tier. Slowest on complex tasks (36s tool use). Eliminated from recommendation.

asi.key_findings: 35B-A3B=89. Improved from 45 but still below the top tier (92-95). Slowest on complex tasks: 36s tool use, 28s bug fix. MoE 3B active params don't help - it's slower than GLM (100 t/s) and even Gemma4-26b (90 t/s) on actual tasks. The thinking/reasoning overhead is the bottleneck.
asi.conclusion: 35B-A3B is NOT recommended for any slot. It's slower AND lower quality than GLM-4.7, and slower AND lower quality than 27B dense on complex tasks.
asi.next_action_hint: 35B-A3B eliminated from all slots. Now have clear top 4: GLM-4.7 (speed+quality), Gemma4-26b (absolute speed), 27B (reliability), 31B (vision). Pick 3.

asi.conclusion: qwen36-apex composite=94, 2nd highest ever. agent=95%, think=93%, speed=92%, reliability=100%. ~97-103 t/s complex, 1.3s speed avg, zero time penalty.
